people.name: David A. Sinclair
people.title: Professor of Genetics; Co-Director, Paul F. Glenn Center for Biology of Aging Research
people.known_for: Sirtuin/NAD+ biology; resveratrol sirtuin activation hypothesis; 'Lifespan' (2019); Cell 2023 OSK partial reprogramming restoring vision in aged mice

people.name: Peter Attia
people.title: Physician, longevity author
people.known_for: 'Outlive' (2023) — 'Four Horsemen' framework (CVD, cancer, neurodegeneration, metabolic dysfunction); Medicine 3.0; ApoB-centric risk; Zone 2 training

people.name: Valter Longo
people.title: Professor of Gerontology and Biological Sciences; Director, USC Longevity Institute
people.affiliation: USC Leonard Davis School of Gerontology
people.known_for: Fasting-Mimicking Diet (FMD / ProLon); Wei 2017 Sci Transl Med showing 5-day FMD reduced biological age markers ~2.5y; 'The Longevity Diet'

people.name: Steve Horvath
people.title: Professor of Human Genetics & Biostatistics (emeritus); now Altos Labs
people.known_for: 2013 Genome Biology paper defining 'Horvath clock' — 353 CpG methylation sites predicting biological age; subsequent GrimAge, DNAm PhenoAge

people.name: Elizabeth H. Blackburn
people.title: Professor Emerita of Biology and Physiology; 2009 Nobel Laureate
people.known_for: Co-discovered telomerase (TERT); awarded 2009 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine (with Greider & Szostak) for telomere/telomerase discovery; 'The Telomere Effect' (2017)

people.name: Carol W. Greider
people.title: Professor of Molecular Biology & Genetics; 2009 Nobel Laureate
people.known_for: Co-discovered telomerase with Blackburn (1984 Cell paper); 2009 Nobel Prize shared

people.name: Judith Campisi
people.title: Professor (emerita)
people.affiliation: Buck Institute for Research on Aging; Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory
people.known_for: Pioneering research on cellular senescence and the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP); showed senescent cells drive tissue dysfunction

people.name: Richard A. Miller
people.title: Professor of Pathology; Director, Paul F. Glenn Center for Aging Research
people.known_for: Co-PI of NIA Interventions Testing Program (ITP); co-author on Harrison 2009 Nature rapamycin lifespan paper

people.name: David E. Harrison
people.title: Senior Research Scientist
people.known_for: Lead author Harrison et al. Nature 2009 — NIA ITP showing rapamycin extended mouse median lifespan +9% (males) / +14% (females) even when started late in life

people.name: Leonard Hayflick
people.title: Professor of Anatomy (emeritus)
people.known_for: 1961 discovery that normal human fibroblasts divide a finite number of times (~50) before senescing — 'Hayflick limit'

people.name: Yoshinori Ohsumi
people.title: Professor Emeritus / 2016 Nobel Laureate
people.known_for: Discovery of autophagy mechanisms in yeast; mapped ATG genes; 2016 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine

people.name: Frank Madeo
people.title: Professor of Molecular Biosciences
people.known_for: Spermidine + autophagy research; Kiechl 2018 prospective cohort showing dietary spermidine intake inversely correlated with all-cause mortality

people.name: Rajagopal Sekhar (Kumar team)
people.title: Professor of Medicine, Endocrinology, Diabetes & Metabolism
people.known_for: GlyNAC (glycine + N-acetylcysteine) trials — Kumar 2022 (Clin Transl Med + J Gerontol) showing GlyNAC improved glutathione, oxidative stress, mitochondrial function, and multiple aging hallmarks in older adults

people.name: Johan Auwerx
people.title: Professor of Energy Metabolism
people.known_for: Urolithin A + mitophagy research; co-founded Amazentis; Andreux 2019 Nature Metabolism first-in-human urolithin A safety/mitophagy trial

people.name: Matthew J. Yousefzadeh
people.title: Assistant Professor
people.affiliation: Columbia University / formerly Mayo Clinic & University of Minnesota (with Niedernhofer & Robbins)
people.known_for: Yousefzadeh et al. 2018 EBioMedicine — fisetin as potent senolytic extending median mouse lifespan ~10%

people.name: James L. Kirkland
people.title: Professor of Medicine, Mayo Clinic Robert and Arlene Kogod Center on Aging (emeritus)
people.known_for: Coined term 'senolytic'; Hickson 2019 EBioMedicine first-in-human dasatinib+quercetin trial in IPF patients

people.name: Tomás A. Prolla
people.title: Professor of Genetics
people.known_for: Caloric restriction gene expression / lifespan biology research

people.name: Nathan K. LeBrasseur
people.title: Professor of Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation; Co-Director Kogod Center on Aging
people.known_for: Senescence + exercise research; frailty biology; collaborator with Kirkland on senolytic translation

people.name: Dan Buettner
people.title: National Geographic Fellow / Journalist
people.known_for: Identified 5 'Blue Zones' (Okinawa Japan, Sardinia Italy, Nicoya Costa Rica, Ikaria Greece, Loma Linda California) with highest centenarian density; 'The Blue Zones' books

people.name: Elissa Epel
people.title: Professor of Psychiatry
people.known_for: Epel et al. 2004 PNAS — chronic psychological stress shortens telomeres; subsequent Blackburn-Epel 'Telomere Effect' framework

people.name: Waziry et al. (CALERIE-2 team)
people.title: Team led by Daniel Belsky
people.known_for: Waziry et al. 2023 Nature Aging — 12% caloric restriction in humans (CALERIE-2) slowed DunedinPACE epigenetic rate-of-aging biomarker

people.name: Jun Yoshino
people.title: Associate Professor
people.affiliation: Washington University School of Medicine / Tokyo Medical and Dental University
people.known_for: Yoshino et al. 2021 Science — 250 mg/day NMN for 10 weeks improved muscle insulin sensitivity in postmenopausal women with prediabetes (N=25)

people.name: Juan Carlos Izpisúa Belmonte
people.title: Professor (Salk Institute → Altos Labs)
people.known_for: Partial cellular reprogramming (OSK/OSKM factors) in vivo — Ocampo 2016 Cell showing transient Yamanaka factors ameliorate aging in mice

molecules.name: NAD+ (Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide)
molecules.role: Central coenzyme for sirtuins, PARPs, CD38; declines ~50% from age 20→60 (Massudi 2012); required for DNA repair, mitochondrial biogenesis

molecules.name: NMN (Nicotinamide Mononucleotide)
molecules.role: Direct precursor to NAD+ in salvage pathway; oral NMN (Yoshino 2021) raised NAD+ and improved insulin sensitivity in postmenopausal women

molecules.name: NR (Nicotinamide Riboside)
molecules.role: Alternative NAD+ precursor; Martens 2018 Nat Commun — 1 g/day NR for 6-8 weeks raised NAD+ ~60% in middle-aged/older adults

molecules.name: SIRT1
molecules.label_th: เซอร์ทูอิน 1
molecules.role: Key longevity regulator; deacetylates p53, FOXO, PGC-1α; NAD+-dependent — activity falls as NAD+ falls

molecules.name: SIRT3
molecules.role: Regulates mitochondrial acetylation; protects against oxidative stress; declines with age

molecules.name: SIRT6
molecules.role: DNA repair (base excision, double-strand); overexpression extends mouse lifespan (Kanfi 2012 Nature)

molecules.name: CD38
molecules.role: Primary NAD+ consumer in mammals; expression increases with age (Camacho-Pereira 2016 Cell Metabolism) driving NAD decline

molecules.name: PARP1
molecules.role: Consumes NAD+ during DNA damage repair; chronic DNA damage (with aging) depletes NAD pool

molecules.name: mTOR (mechanistic Target of Rapamycin)
molecules.role: Master nutrient/growth sensor; active mTORC1 suppresses autophagy and accelerates aging; inhibited by rapamycin (Harrison 2009 ITP)

molecules.name: p16INK4a (CDKN2A)
molecules.role: Canonical marker of cellular senescence; accumulates in tissues with age; Baker 2016 Nature — clearing p16+ cells extended healthy lifespan in mice

molecules.name: p21 (CDKN1A)
molecules.role: Alternative senescence marker downstream of p53; induced by DNA damage and oxidative stress

molecules.name: Telomerase (TERT holoenzyme)
molecules.label_th: เทโลเมอเรส
molecules.role: Enzyme that adds TTAGGG repeats to telomere ends; Blackburn/Greider/Szostak 2009 Nobel; silent in most somatic cells → telomere shortening with age

molecules.name: Resveratrol (trans-resveratrol)
molecules.label_th: เรสเวอราทรอล
molecules.role: Found in grape skin/red wine; Sinclair 2003 Nature — activated SIRT1 in vitro (mechanism debated by Pacholec 2010); poor oral bioavailability

molecules.name: Pterostilbene
molecules.label_th: เทอโรสทิลบีน
molecules.role: Higher oral bioavailability than resveratrol (~80% vs ~20%); longer half-life; often paired with NR (Basis / Elysium)

molecules.name: Spermidine
molecules.label_th: สเปอร์มิดีน
molecules.role: Induces autophagy via EP300 inhibition; dietary sources: wheat germ, aged cheese, natto; Kiechl 2018 cohort — high intake → lower all-cause mortality

molecules.name: Urolithin A
molecules.label_th: ยูโรลิธิน A
molecules.role: Produced by gut bacteria from ellagitannins (pomegranate, berries, walnuts); induces mitophagy; Andreux 2019 Nat Metab first-in-human safety trial

molecules.name: Fisetin
molecules.role: Found in strawberries, apples, onions; Yousefzadeh 2018 EBioMedicine — fisetin senolytic, extended mouse median lifespan ~10%

molecules.name: Quercetin
molecules.label_th: เคอร์เซติน
molecules.role: Senolytic component of Kirkland D+Q protocol; Hickson 2019 EBioMedicine — dasatinib 100 mg + quercetin 1000 mg cleared senescent cells in IPF patients

molecules.name: Coenzyme Q10 / Ubiquinol
molecules.label_th: โคเอนไซม์ Q10
molecules.role: Mitochondrial electron transport chain complexes I→III; endogenous synthesis declines ~50% by age 80; ubiquinol (reduced) form more bioavailable

molecules.name: Glutathione (GSH)
molecules.label_th: กลูตาไธโอน
molecules.role: Master intracellular antioxidant; declines with age; GlyNAC (glycine + NAC) replenishes by providing both rate-limiting precursors (Kumar 2022)

molecules.name: GlyNAC (Glycine + N-Acetylcysteine)
molecules.role: Kumar 2022 (J Gerontol + Clin Transl Med) — supplementation in older adults improved glutathione, oxidative stress, insulin resistance, endothelial function, cognition

molecules.name: Rapamycin (Sirolimus)
molecules.label_th: แร็ปพามายซิน
molecules.role: Isolated from Easter Island (Rapa Nui) soil bacterium; FDA-approved immunosuppressant; Harrison 2009 — first drug shown to extend lifespan in mammals. PRESCRIPTION — educational discussion only, NEVER product angle

molecules.name: Hydrolyzed Collagen (Collagen Peptides)
molecules.label_th: คอลลาเจนไฮโดรไลซ์
molecules.role: 2-5 kDa peptides including Pro-Hyp, Hyp-Gly that signal dermal fibroblasts; Proksch 2014 + Choi 2019 meta-analyses — modest skin elasticity/hydration improvement

molecules.name: OSK (Oct4, Sox2, Klf4) factors
molecules.role: Subset of Yamanaka OSKM reprogramming factors; transient expression in Sinclair Cell 2023 restored vision in aged mouse optic nerve via epigenetic reset

case_studies.name: Blackburn/Greider/Szostak Nobel 2009 — Telomerase Discovery
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 2009 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 'for the discovery of how chromosomes are protected by telomeres and the enzyme telomerase'

case_studies.name: Harrison 2009 NIA ITP Rapamycin Lifespan
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Rapamycin fed to 600-day-old (equivalent to ~60-year-old humans) genetically heterogeneous mice extended median lifespan +9% males, +14% females — first drug proven to extend mammalian lifespan when started late in life

case_studies.name: Horvath Epigenetic Clock 2013
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Single mathematical model using 353 CpG methylation sites accurately predicts chronological age across 51 tissues/cell types (R=0.96); deviation = biological age acceleration

case_studies.name: Yousefzadeh Fisetin Senolytic 2018
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Screened 10 flavonoids for senolytic activity in murine and human senescent cells; fisetin most potent; oral fisetin extended median survival of aged mice by ~10%

case_studies.name: Wei 2017 Fasting-Mimicking Diet
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Three monthly cycles of 5-day FMD in N=100 adults reduced BMI, blood pressure, IGF-1, CRP and lowered multiple aging biomarkers (authors estimated ~2.5 year reduction in biological age)
case_studies.source: Wei M et al., Science Translational Medicine 9:eaai8700, 2017

case_studies.name: Kumar 2022 GlyNAC Trial
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Randomized open-label trial in older adults (N=24, age 70-80) — 16 weeks GlyNAC (glycine 100 mg/kg + NAC 100 mg/kg) improved glutathione deficiency, mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative stress, inflammation, insulin resistance, endothelial dysfunction, genotoxicity, muscle strength, cognition, body composition, gait speed
case_studies.source: Kumar P, Sekhar RV et al., J Gerontol Ser A Biol Sci Med Sci glac135, 2022

case_studies.name: Sinclair 2023 Cell OSK Epigenetic Reset
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Transient AAV-delivered OSK (Oct4/Sox2/Klf4) factors reset DNA methylation age in aged mouse retinal ganglion cells and restored vision — first evidence of safe partial reprogramming reversing age-related vision loss in vivo
case_studies.source: Lu Y et al., Nature 588:124-129, 2020 (Sinclair lab); Yang JH et al., Cell 186:305-326, 2023

case_studies.name: Baker 2016 — Clearing p16+ Senescent Cells
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Naturally occurring p16Ink4a-positive senescent cells cleared by INK-ATTAC transgene extended median healthy lifespan ~25% in mice and delayed age-related dysfunction in kidney, heart, and fat

case_studies.name: Massudi 2012 NAD Decline with Age
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Measured NAD+ in human skin biopsies across ages — NAD+ dropped ~50% from age 20-30 to age 60-70, with corresponding SIRT1 decline
case_studies.source: Massudi H et al., PLoS ONE 7:e42357, 2012

case_studies.name: Yoshino 2021 NMN Women
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 250 mg/day NMN for 10 weeks in N=25 postmenopausal women with prediabetes improved muscle insulin sensitivity (hyperinsulinemic-euglycemic clamp) — first peer-reviewed RCT showing NMN clinical efficacy
case_studies.source: Yoshino M, Yoshino J et al., Science 372:1224-1229, 2021

case_studies.name: Waziry 2023 CALERIE-2 DunedinPACE
case_studies.claim_to_fame: N=220 non-obese adults, 2 years of ~12% caloric restriction — slowed the DunedinPACE epigenetic rate-of-aging biomarker 2-3% versus ad libitum controls (first RCT evidence that CR slows biological aging in humans)
case_studies.source: Waziry R et al., Nature Aging 3:248-257, 2023

case_studies.name: Hayflick Limit 1961
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Normal human fibroblasts divide ~40-60 times in vitro before irreversible senescence — overturning the dogma that somatic cells were immortal in culture
case_studies.source: Hayflick L, Moorhead PS. Exp Cell Res 25:585-621, 1961

case_studies.name: Hickson 2019 Dasatinib + Quercetin First-in-Human
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Open-label pilot in N=14 IPF patients — 3 cycles of D 100 mg + Q 1250 mg improved physical function (6-min walk, gait speed, sit-to-stand)
